reviews.title: Love this app, but let’s make it more accessible!
reviews.text: Obviously people that use drugs will find the money to buy the drugs. But I feel like quitting a drug is more about accessibility to the general public. Drugs are more commonly used in regions with lower income, so I think dropping the price down a little bit will be more accessible for those people.

reviews.title: 360 days
reviews.text: I am 360 days no vaping and no nicotine and I can safely say this app changed my life. It has lots of encouraging messages and it tells you not only how much progress you’ve made, but also how much your body heals day by day. This app has helped me more ways than one and it has helped keep me accountable. It is nice to look back and see how far I’ve come. It shows you how much money you save, how many vapes you’ve avoided and so much more. I can’t say enough good things about this app. Truly. Not mention it has a forum built in to allow you to talk to others who are quitting and it has resources as well. I highly recommend this app to anyone quitting nicotine and to those who are trying, don’t give up. A whole new life is just a day at a time away.

reviews.title: This app is awesome!
reviews.text: This app inspired me to quit and gave me positive reinforcement every time I needed help! And most of all of it for free! I couldn’t afford any other app but this app gave me a chance to be a new person and it’s helped me to quit and stay off vaping for 2 years and 33 days. I also saw that they made a quit drinking app and because of that app I actually stopped drinking. It motivated me and inspired me to actually get off drinking. the days tracking and communicating with buddy’s and the milestones helped a lot. So very proud of the developers for creating all this and allowing it to be used for free! Awesome developers gave many people the opportunity to access resources that other apps would charge unreasonably!

reviews.title: SO tired of money-hungry apps & subscriptions
reviews.text: Remember the good days when you could pay $0.99–$4.99 for an app and have full access forever? I saw the great reviews and thought it was free, so I downloaded it. It asks you a few preliminary questions, then immediately prompts you to pay either $99.99/year or $19.99/month. No free trial, just “pay me before you even see what I have to offer.” Not that I would ever pay that much for an app on my phone anyway. Maybe one day we’ll get apps that care more about helping people than milking subscriptions.

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: I bought this on the monthly pay plan and randomly got charged the full yearly plan. I tried to cancel it and it won’t give me my money back. When I go in the app, it doesn’t even show that I have the plan and everything is locked. It was a waste of my money and I want my money back.

reviews.title: Great app but… Bradley
reviews.text: This app helped my gf follow me on quitting, there’s a great community except for someone named… Bradley. He has joined a lot of the group chats in here and seems to be trolling to get people to vape. He says he’s paid people to quit vaping but then tells people they should vape and it’s not worth it to quit. Bradley, if you’re reading this, it’s me, your father. Come home, your mother has been so sad without you. I’m sorry for calling you a disappointment in front of all your friends. I’m proud of you.

reviews.title: Buggy and expensive

Save yourself the $30 PER MONTH and use a simple spreadsheet.

reviews.title: Lifechanging
reviews.text: This app really was a great support system in my decision to quit. The community on this app root for one another and all help support eachother to stick to our commitments to quit. It really kept me going and most definitely made a huge impact on my consistency with sticking to it. Thats not to say the app is a quick fix, you still have to have the willpower and mental discipline to quit. But this app gave structure and a community that I would have not ever found anywhere else. I quit vaping almost 2 years ago, and I still return to the app to see my progress and help others. Im so grateful toward the community on the app and creators of this app.
